query:
DELETE FROM feedback_not_needed AS n
            WHERE n.tenant_id = $1 AND n.project_id = $2 AND n.user_sub = $4
              AND n.feedback_id IN (
                  SELECT f.id FROM feedback AS f
                  WHERE f.tenant_id = $1 AND f.project_id = $2 AND f.short_code = $3
              )
